boxes.label: Home mortgage interest paid that no Form 1098 reports, including a seller-financed mortgage
Points paid that no Form 1098 reports
Interest paid on money borrowed to buy property held for investment
Seller-financed mortgage: name of the person the home was bought from and the interest paid to
boxes.notes: Schedule A line 8b, seller financed mortgage. The i1040sca text reads: 'write that person's name, identifying number, and address on the dotted lines next to line 8b.' (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/i1040sca--2025.pdf).

boxes.label: Seller-financed mortgage: that person's identifying number (SSN if an individual, otherwise EIN)
boxes.notes: Schedule A line 8b. The i1040sca text reads: 'write that person's name, identifying number, and address on the dotted lines next to line 8b.' (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/i1040sca--2025.pdf).

boxes.label: Seller-financed mortgage: that person's address
boxes.notes: Schedule A line 8b. The i1040sca text reads: 'write that person's name, identifying number, and address on the dotted lines next to line 8b.' (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/i1040sca--2025.pdf).

boxes.label: The points were paid on a loan used to buy or build the main home
boxes.notes: Pub. 936's test for deducting points in the year paid. The p936 text reads: 'You use your loan to buy or build your main home.' (https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-prior/p936--2025.pdf).

document.notes: Interest paid to the person the taxpayer bought the home from is reported here, and Schedule A line 8b requires that person's name, identifying number and address alongside it. Investment interest needs Form 4952 and is limited to net investment income.

extraction.note: A taxpayer's own record. No prescribed layout, so no structured model and no boxes to read: it prints ITEMS in the client's own words, and which declared box each belongs in is a JUDGEMENT a person confirms (spec 075 group D, clarification Q1). Read by the declared custom model in TRANSCRIBE mode - the same reader, a second template - which copies every line verbatim and names no destination. A separate, cheap proposal call then suggests a box per item; **only a box a person confirms places anything**, so an engagement with nineteen rental sheets shows an empty Schedule E until somebody has looked. That is the decision, not a defect.
